def transform(grid):

    col_modes = [mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]
    rc, cc = Counter(row_modes), Counter(col_modes)
    shared = set(rc) & set(cc)
    # The scaffold color is the rare common row/column mode; the frequent one
    # is the fill color of the large cells.
    line_color = min(shared, key=lambda x: rc[x] + cc[x])
    fill_candidates = [x for x in shared if x != line_color]
    background = max(fill_candidates, key=lambda x: rc[x] + cc[x]) if fill_candidates else mode([v for row in grid for v in row])
    rows = [i for i, x in enumerate(row_modes) if x == line_color]
    cols = [i for i, x in enumerate(col_modes) if x == line_color]
